missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Песок' is the nominative subject, keeping its fleeting vowel 'о'. 'Мягкий' and 'жёлтый' are the agreeing masculine adjectives. A clean descriptive model.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Песок' is the accusative object of 'насыпали'; as an inanimate masculine noun it matches the nominative. 'В ведро' shows the destination.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Песка' is the genitive after 'нет'; the fleeting vowel 'о' drops in all cases but the nominative. A core declension point for this noun.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'к'. 'Песку' is the dative after 'к', and the fleeting vowel again drops. The preposition marks the goal toward which the water moves.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'На песке' uses the prepositional 'песке' after 'на' to mark location. 'Тёплом' is the agreeing masculine prepositional adjective.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Песком' is the instrumental marking the material with 'засыпана'. 'Белым' is the agreeing masculine instrumental adjective. The fleeting vowel stays dropped.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Песка' is the genitive after 'много' to express an amount of an uncountable substance. The fleeting vowel drops as expected.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В песке' uses the prepositional after 'в' to say where the car is stuck. 'Глубоком' is the agreeing masculine prepositional adjective.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Пески' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'скрипят'; the plural keeps the dropped vowel. 'Мелкие' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'по'. 'Песку' is the dative after 'по' to express movement along a surface. 'Горячему' is the agreeing masculine dative adjective.
